en.title: October 3: The 3 Zodiac Animals With the Best Luck on Gaecheonjeol, Korea's 4,359th Founding Day
en.excerpt: It's Gaecheonjeol, Korea's National Foundation Day, marking 4,359 years since Dangun founded Gojoseon. Here are the three zodiac animals catching the best luck today, and why.
